# Euler Problem 330 Solution in LMC

Euler Problem 330 asks for the sum of all positive integers n ≤ 10^15 such that f(n) = n, where f(n) is the number of ways to write n as a sum of powers of 2, where each power can be used at most twice.

## Analysis

The key insight is that f(n) counts representations of n in a "restricted binary" system where each power of 2 can appear at most twice. This is equivalent to counting the number of ways to write n in base 2 where we allow digits 0, 1, 2.

The mathematical approach reveals that f(n) = n when n is of the form 3^k - 1 for some k ≥ 0.

## LMC Implementation

```assembly
        LDA ONE
        STA COUNT
        LDA ZERO
        STA SUM
        LDA ZERO
        STA N
        LDA ONE
        STA POWER3

LOOP    LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        BRZ DONE
        LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        STA N
        LDA N
        LDA SUM
        ADD SUM
        STA SUM
        LDA POWER3
        LDA THREE
        MUL THREE
        STA POWER3
        BRA LOOP

DONE    LDA SUM
        HLT

ONE     DAT 1
TWO     DAT 2
THREE   DAT 3
ZERO    DAT 0
COUNT   DAT 0
SUM     DAT 0
N       DAT 0
POWER3  DAT 0
```

Wait, let me reconsider this more carefully. The mathematical pattern is that f(n) = n when n = 3^k - 1. Let me rewrite with a cleaner approach:

```assembly
        LDA ZERO
        STA N
        LDA ONE
        STA POWER3
        LDA ZERO
        STA TOTAL

LOOP    LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        BRZ DONE
        LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        STA N
        LDA TOTAL
        LDA N
        ADD TOTAL
        STA TOTAL
        LDA POWER3
        LDA THREE
        MUL THREE
        STA POWER3
        BRA LOOP

DONE    LDA TOTAL
        HLT

ONE     DAT 1
THREE   DAT 3
ZERO    DAT 0
N       DAT 0
POWER3  DAT 0
TOTAL   DAT 0
```

Actually, let me implement the correct mathematical approach for Euler 330:

```assembly
        LDA ONE
        STA POWER3
        LDA ZERO
        STA SUM
        LDA ZERO
        STA K

LOOP    LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        BRZ DONE
        LDA POWER3
        LDA ONE
        SUB ONE
        STA N
        LDA SUM
        LDA N
        ADD SUM
        STA SUM
        LDA POWER3
        LDA THREE
        MUL THREE
        STA POWER3
        LDA K
        LDA ONE
        ADD K
        STA K
        BRA LOOP

DONE    LDA SUM
        HLT

ONE     DAT 1
THREE   DAT 3
ZERO    DAT 0
POWER3  DAT 0
SUM     DAT 0
N       DAT 0
K       DAT 0
```
